minutes.headline: Board approved the Reservoir Road driveway permit if taxes are paid; 40 Pioneer Drive hearing continued to Aug 28.
minutes.summary: The board heard a lot consolidation on Electric Avenue, an approval-not-required lot on Prospect Street, and a flood plain special permit for a driveway at 675 Reservoir Road, where a neighbor raised drainage complaints. It heard revisions for 40 Pioneer Drive and continued that hearing. It also started a permit review of the Electric Avenue parking lots and named a member to the Charter Review Committee.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board approved a flood plain special permit for a driveway at 675 Reservoir Road, on condition that outstanding taxes are paid.
The 40 Pioneer Drive hearing was continued to August 28 at the applicant's request, after the board granted a horizontal datum waiver.
The board found it had too little time to review late 40 Pioneer Drive materials and took no action on them that night.
The board voted to start a permit review of the parking lots at 5 and 9 Electric Avenue, with the date amended to September 11 or 12.
The board appointed one of its members to the Charter Review Committee.

why_it_matters: Driveway drainage on Reservoir Road was raised by neighbors, and the permit follows a check of conservation order conditions and contact with the DPW, so water runoff near homes is the practical question.
The Electric Avenue parking review and the 40 Pioneer Drive hearing are steps that decide how those sites may be used, and each has later public meetings where residents can comment.
watch_next: August 28: continued hearing on 40 Pioneer Drive.
September 11 or 12: permit review of the 5 and 9 Electric Avenue parking lots, with the property owner and zoning commissioner invited.
